title: sarothamnus albus
intro: Sarothamnus albus, commonly known as white broom or Adenocarpus albus, is a flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its ability to treat respiratory issues and its antimicrobial properties, helping to reduce inflammation and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Sarothamus albus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
